set.body:
Source: PRD.html sections 7, 10, and requirements F-09 and Q-06.

Scope:
- Define a bounded, framed, versioned client-agent protocol.
- Launch a fixed scala-slurm-agent serve --stdio command through the configured system OpenSSH path.
- Keep user values inside protocol frames rather than dynamically constructed remote shell commands.
- Invoke the same CLI Scheduler[F] interpreter on the HPC system.
- Add paged remote log/result access, reconnect behavior, capability handshake, and explicit degraded direct-SSH compatibility semantics.
- Preserve host-key, agent, proxy, MFA, and user-authority behavior without persisting credentials.

Acceptance:
- The local and SSH paths pass one differential scheduler conformance suite.
- SSH disconnect does not cancel a scheduler-accepted job.
- Reconnection resumes paged logs from the supplied byte cursor.
- Protocol mismatch, agent absence, authentication failure, and remote CLI failure remain distinct diagnostics.
set.title: P2: Add SSH agent execution with local semantic parity
